Try Grok @Bot. It’s like hiring an amazing assistant!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Texas Twins Dad (@Texas_Twins_Dad); megjelent: 2026-11-03T20:59:37+00:00; link: https://x.com/Texas_Twins_Dad/status/2117723394330460528; média: 1 kép]
New Grok Bot feature I just discovered on a call. My bot called my car insurance today to ask why my renewal went up 14% with zero accidents. Mid-call, the rep asked a question.

The bot didn't hang up. It didn't make me take over the call. A question card popped up in my chat. I typed the answer, and the bot kept the call going on its own.

It's like passing a note to my assistant while they're still on the phone.

Grok Bot is like hiring my personal assistant!
